slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Motivation har din nahi aati. Discipline low days me bhi tumhe aage badhati hai.
slides.note: Start even when you do not feel like it.

slides.body: Aaj mood nahi hai, isliye goal postpone karna easy lagta hai.
Jo kaam tum repeat karte ho, wahi dheere-dheere tumhari identity ban jaata hai.
Full workout nahi? 10 minutes. Full chapter nahi? 2 pages. Chain mat todo.
slides.note: Make the habit easy to continue.

slides.body: Aaj ka ek important kaam decide karo aur use distractions se pehle complete karo.
Aaj bas apna minimum version complete karo. Kal ka confidence wahi banayega.

caption:
Motivation ka wait karoge to progress ruk jayegi.

Aaj apna minimum version complete karo—small action, but no zero day.
